reviews.text: Very enjoyable class, even with two midterms and a final exam (true/false and multiple choice). Lowest exam score was dropped, minimal studying required, just review the slides and your notes. Both professors keep lectures engaging and not too serious, and are great at explaining things clearly. There is extra credit, almost no homework (there is a small group project), and we also got free plants from the GSIs!
